open.fact: This round did not re-open the Toray M60J sheet, DOI 10.1021/acsanm.3c01282, the textbook pages that print 3820 and 3530, the AlBeMet sheet, the 3M AF 163-2 table, or the SAE extract. Index arithmetic from the stated inputs reproduces. Those inputs are unchecked.

066 measured a face-strength slope of zero at 345 MPa because yield is not binding there. The SAE minimum is 206.8 MPa. Whether that floor stays off the bind was not run. This review does not run the hull model.
The filed 100 mm diameter is not on the mechanical page. The disks page checked today says up to 120 mm. The CVD booklet named in 067 was not opened, so a 100 mm line in that booklet is unchecked.

Density over modulus to the power 0.514 is the local slope ratio at concept R 30 ISA. It is not a re-optimized hull clear. The linear modulus factor matching a density factor of 1.743 would be about 2.95, while 066's measured concept-ISA closure was near 2.09 to 2.12 and concept optimistic did not close on modulus.
